prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `escape` and `unescape` in src/lib.rs for JSON strings. `escape` must turn `"` into `\"`, `\` into `\\`, newline/tab/carriage return into `\n`/`\t`/`\r`, and every other control character below U+0020 into `\u00XX` with four lowercase hex digits. `unescape` must reverse those escapes and return `None` for an unknown escape, a trailing backslash, or an invalid `\u` escape. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
